completion_rule: Only verified requirements count as complete. verified requires evidence paths and passing acceptance checks.

requirements.title: Frozen canonical specification
requirements.description: The canonical project specification and requirement catalogue are immutable to Claude Code unless the owner explicitly enables specification editing.
requirements.acceptance: Automated hook blocks Claude edits to docs/MASTER_SPEC.md and requirements/requirements.json; integrity audit passes.

requirements.title: Requirement traceability
requirements.description: Every required feature has a stable requirement ID, milestone, implementation status, and evidence list.
requirements.acceptance: Audit reports no missing, duplicate, or orphan requirement IDs.

requirements.title: Evidence-based completion
requirements.description: No requirement may be marked complete using prose alone, TODOs, mocks, or unexecuted code.
requirements.acceptance: Every complete requirement lists existing test, benchmark, report, or demo evidence paths.

requirements.title: Exchange/participant separation
requirements.description: Exchange-side sequencing and matching remain architecturally separate from participant-side feed handling, strategy, risk, OMS, and portfolio logic.
requirements.acceptance: Architecture tests and dependency rules prevent participant strategy code from directly mutating the exchange book.

requirements.title: Determinism before optimization
requirements.description: Correctness and deterministic replay are mandatory before memory, concurrency, or latency optimizations.
requirements.acceptance: Identical event input and seed produce byte-identical canonical output before performance milestone begins.

requirements.title: No fabricated claims
requirements.description: All CV, README, performance, and trading-result claims must derive from committed reproducible evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Claims audit finds no unsupported numeric statements or guaranteed-profit/interview language.

requirements.title: One active milestone
requirements.description: Only one milestone may be active in the primary implementation branch; later milestones cannot silently leak into scope.
requirements.acceptance: BUILD_STATE.md identifies one active milestone and audit detects edits outside its permitted scope unless documented.

requirements.title: Decision records
requirements.description: Material architecture changes require an ADR describing context, decision, alternatives, and consequences.
requirements.acceptance: Each nontrivial architecture change references an accepted ADR.

requirements.title: Reproducible environments
requirements.description: Build, test, data, and benchmark environments are versioned and reproducible.
requirements.acceptance: Clean environment instructions build and run integrity tests without undocumented steps.

requirements.title: Secrets isolation
requirements.description: Claude and source control are denied access to .env, credentials, private keys, and secrets directories.
requirements.acceptance: Project settings deny sensitive paths and secret-scanning checks pass.

requirements.title: Exchange and instrument metadata
requirements.description: Store exchange, product, instrument, tick-size, multiplier, currency, timezone, and session metadata.
requirements.acceptance: Schema validation and fixtures cover at least three futures product families.

requirements.title: Contract symbols and expiry metadata
requirements.description: Represent individual futures contracts, expiry dates, first/last trade dates, settlement and delivery metadata.
requirements.acceptance: Contract lookup and expiry-boundary tests pass.

requirements.title: Trading-session calendars
requirements.description: Represent sessions, holidays, maintenance windows, and overnight boundaries.
requirements.acceptance: Session classification tests cover normal, holiday, overnight, and DST cases.

requirements.title: Volume and open-interest ingestion
requirements.description: Ingest and validate volume/open-interest fields used by roll policies.
requirements.acceptance: Data-quality report identifies missing, stale, and contradictory values.

requirements.title: Fixed-days roll policy
requirements.description: Roll a configurable number of sessions before expiry.
requirements.acceptance: Golden fixtures match expected roll dates.

requirements.title: Volume-crossover roll policy
requirements.description: Roll when deferred-contract volume exceeds front-contract volume under configurable persistence rules.
requirements.acceptance: Golden fixtures cover crossover, reversal, and missing-volume cases.

requirements.title: Open-interest-crossover roll policy
requirements.description: Roll using configurable open-interest crossover rules.
requirements.acceptance: Golden fixtures cover crossover and missing-open-interest cases.

requirements.title: Liquidity-score roll policy
requirements.description: Support a documented composite liquidity score for contract selection.
requirements.acceptance: Score components, weights, and selected contracts are reproducible.

requirements.title: Unadjusted continuous series
requirements.description: Construct unadjusted continuous futures series while preserving raw contract prices.
requirements.acceptance: Output includes contract provenance for every observation.

requirements.title: Difference-adjusted continuous series
requirements.description: Construct additive back-adjusted series.
requirements.acceptance: Known roll-gap fixtures preserve returns according to documented convention.

requirements.title: Ratio-adjusted continuous series
requirements.description: Construct multiplicative ratio-adjusted series.
requirements.acceptance: Known roll-gap fixtures preserve proportional returns.

requirements.title: Return-preserving series
requirements.description: Construct a return stream and optional synthetic index that avoids artificial roll jumps.
requirements.acceptance: Return reconciliation tests pass across all rolls.

requirements.title: Roll audit report
requirements.description: Produce per-roll audit records with old/new contracts, prices, raw gap, trigger, and adjustment.
requirements.acceptance: Machine-readable and human-readable reports match fixtures.

requirements.title: Roll-method sensitivity
requirements.description: Research can compare results across roll policies and adjustment methods.
requirements.acceptance: One experiment report quantifies strategy differences caused by roll choices.

requirements.title: Bad-data detection
requirements.description: Detect duplicates, gaps, invalid prices, impossible timestamps, and contract metadata conflicts.

requirements.title: Normalized multi-market schema
requirements.description: Normalize futures data from multiple products into one versioned schema.
requirements.acceptance: At least three product fixtures load through one interface.

requirements.title: Price-time-priority order book
requirements.description: Implement a central limit order book with deterministic FIFO priority within each price level.
requirements.acceptance: Golden sequence tests prove price and time priority.

requirements.title: Limit orders
requirements.description: Accept valid limit orders and rest or match them as appropriate.
requirements.acceptance: Unit tests cover bid, ask, crossing, noncrossing, and invalid input.

requirements.title: Market orders
requirements.description: Execute market orders against available liquidity with explicit residual handling.
requirements.acceptance: Tests cover full fill, partial fill, empty book, and residual policy.

requirements.title: Cancel requests
requirements.description: Cancel resting orders by order ID without searching an entire price queue.
requirements.acceptance: Cancellation tests verify state, quantities, and emitted events.

requirements.title: Quantity modifications
requirements.description: Support documented priority semantics for quantity reductions and increases.
requirements.acceptance: Tests prove priority is retained or lost exactly as documented.

requirements.title: Price modifications
requirements.description: Treat price change with explicit cancel-replace semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Tests prove old priority removal and new-level placement.

requirements.title: Partial fills
requirements.description: Correctly update remaining quantity and emit fill events for partial executions.
requirements.acceptance: Property tests conserve quantity across arbitrary partial-fill sequences.

requirements.title: Full fills
requirements.description: Remove fully filled orders and empty price levels.
requirements.acceptance: Tests verify no dangling references or incorrect aggregate quantities.

requirements.title: Rejected orders
requirements.description: Reject malformed, duplicate, nonpositive, out-of-range, or otherwise invalid orders.
requirements.acceptance: Validation matrix covers each rejection reason.

requirements.title: Order-ID index
requirements.description: Maintain expected O(1) order lookup using a pre-sized index.
requirements.acceptance: Lookup/cancel benchmark and correctness tests exist; documentation avoids strict worst-case claims.

requirements.title: Intrusive FIFO price queues
requirements.description: Store orders at a price using intrusive doubly linked queues or an equivalently allocation-free structure.
requirements.acceptance: Insertion/removal tests and allocation counters pass on warmed path.

requirements.title: Price-level index
requirements.description: Use an explicitly documented tree, tick-array/bitset, or hybrid level index.
requirements.acceptance: Complexity and price-domain assumptions are documented and tested.

requirements.title: Output-sensitive matching
requirements.description: Matching complexity is documented as O(k) for k consumed resting orders.
requirements.acceptance: Benchmark workloads include single- and multi-fill aggressors.

requirements.title: Configurable matching rules
requirements.description: Architecture permits later FIFO/pro-rata variants without contaminating the initial FIFO core.
requirements.acceptance: Matching-policy interface and FIFO implementation tests exist.

requirements.title: Invariant checker
requirements.description: Provide an expensive debug-only book invariant validator.
requirements.acceptance: Fuzz/property tests run invariant checks after generated operations.

requirements.title: Preallocated order pool
requirements.description: Allocate order storage before the critical path.
requirements.acceptance: Warmed matching benchmark records zero general-heap allocations.

requirements.title: Arena/free-list reuse
requirements.description: Recycle order nodes safely using an arena or free list.
requirements.acceptance: Exhaustion, reuse, and generation-safety tests pass.

requirements.title: Cache-aware layout
requirements.description: Document and benchmark structure layout, alignment, and hot/cold field separation.
requirements.acceptance: Size/alignment report and comparative benchmark are committed.

requirements.title: Compact event representation
requirements.description: Use versioned compact event structures without unsafe ABI assumptions.
requirements.acceptance: Serialization round-trip and schema-version tests pass.

requirements.title: Lock-free MPSC ingress
requirements.description: Use a bounded lock-free multi-producer/single-consumer queue around the single-writer engine where justified.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrency stress test proves no loss, duplication, or reordering beyond defined sequencing.

requirements.title: Single-writer matching core
requirements.description: Exactly one writer mutates each order-book partition.
requirements.acceptance: Thread-ownership assertions and architecture tests pass.

requirements.title: Lock-free output queues
requirements.description: Publish fills and market-data events through bounded queues with explicit backpressure policy.
requirements.acceptance: Stress tests cover saturation and shutdown.

requirements.title: Instrument sharding
requirements.description: Partition instruments across cores without sharing mutable books.
requirements.acceptance: Multi-instrument test verifies deterministic per-instrument order and routing.

requirements.title: Core-pinning support
requirements.description: Provide optional Linux CPU affinity for benchmarks, not as a hidden requirement for correctness.

requirements.title: No premature optimization
requirements.description: Optimized implementations must be compared against a correct baseline.
requirements.acceptance: Benchmark report includes baseline and optimized versions plus equivalence tests.

requirements.title: Tail-latency measurement
requirements.description: Record median, p95, p99, p99.9, max, throughput, CPU, and allocations.
requirements.acceptance: Benchmark report includes all required statistics.

requirements.title: Platform-specific benchmark disclosure
requirements.description: Low-latency claims disclose hardware, OS, compiler, flags, logging, workload, and virtualization.
requirements.acceptance: Benchmark audit passes and labels WSL/container results as non-production-comparable.

requirements.title: Original-speed replay
requirements.description: Replay timestamped historical events at original relative timing.
requirements.acceptance: Timing tolerance tests pass on deterministic virtual clock.

requirements.title: Accelerated replay
requirements.description: Replay at configurable speed multipliers.
requirements.acceptance: Tests validate ordering and scaled timing.

requirements.title: Fixed-rate replay
requirements.description: Replay at a configurable event rate independent of original gaps.

requirements.title: Step-by-step replay
requirements.description: Advance one event or one timestamp group at a time.

requirements.title: Deterministic benchmark mode
requirements.description: Replay without wall-clock sleeps using a virtual clock.

requirements.title: Unified strategy interface
requirements.description: The same strategy API works with historical replay, simulated exchange, and paper-feed adapters.
requirements.acceptance: Contract tests run one strategy against multiple feed implementations.

requirements.title: Fault injection: delayed data
requirements.description: Inject deterministic data delay.
requirements.acceptance: Scenario fixtures verify delayed observations and stale-data responses.

requirements.title: Fault injection: missing/duplicate/gap
requirements.description: Inject missing, duplicated, and sequence-gap events.
requirements.acceptance: Feed recovery tests cover each fault.

requirements.title: Fault injection: market stress
requirements.description: Inject spread widening, volatility spikes, and disappearing liquidity.
requirements.acceptance: Scenario results and risk responses are reproducible.

requirements.title: Fault injection: execution stress
requirements.description: Inject rejection, latency, partial-fill, and output-backpressure events.
requirements.acceptance: OMS/risk integration tests cover each fault.

requirements.title: Full-depth snapshots
requirements.description: Load complete book snapshots into participant-side state.
requirements.acceptance: Snapshot fixtures reconstruct expected levels and quantities.

requirements.title: Incremental updates
requirements.description: Apply ordered price- or order-level updates.

requirements.title: Order-level reconstruction
requirements.description: Support market-by-order reconstruction when data permits.

requirements.title: Price-level reconstruction
requirements.description: Support market-by-price reconstruction when only aggregated depth exists.

requirements.title: Sequence validation
requirements.description: Validate monotonic sequence numbers and detect gaps, resets, and duplicates.

requirements.title: Stale-data detection
requirements.description: Mark market state stale after configurable time or sequence conditions.

requirements.title: Snapshot recovery
requirements.description: Recover from a detected gap using a new snapshot and buffered deltas.
requirements.acceptance: Recovery fixtures end in correct state.

requirements.title: Top-of-book metrics
requirements.description: Calculate best bid/ask, spread, and mid-price.

requirements.title: Microprice
requirements.description: Calculate a documented quantity-weighted microprice.
requirements.acceptance: Numeric fixtures pass and edge cases are defined.

requirements.title: Depth and order-book imbalance
requirements.description: Calculate configurable depth/quantity imbalance.
requirements.acceptance: Numeric fixtures across multiple levels pass.

requirements.title: Trade/cancellation intensity
requirements.description: Calculate rolling trade and cancellation intensity.

requirements.title: Queue depletion and adverse selection
requirements.description: Track queue depletion signals and post-fill adverse-selection windows.

requirements.title: Calendar spread construction
requirements.description: Construct near/far futures spreads with explicit contract and roll provenance.
requirements.acceptance: Research dataset can reproduce every spread observation.

requirements.title: Term structure features
requirements.description: Represent carry, contango/backwardation, expiry distance, and roll context.
requirements.acceptance: Feature tests use known curve shapes.

requirements.title: Calendar-spread hedge ratio
requirements.description: Support documented static or rolling hedge-ratio estimation.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic and historical tests validate estimates.

requirements.title: Calendar-spread stationarity
requirements.description: Test rather than assume spread stationarity.
requirements.acceptance: Report includes chosen test, assumptions, and caveats.

requirements.title: Calendar-spread z-score signals
requirements.description: Generate leakage-free rolling entry/exit signals.
requirements.acceptance: Signal timestamps use only contemporaneously available data.

requirements.title: Expiry and roll effects
requirements.description: Evaluate how expiry proximity and roll dates affect calendar-spread behavior.

requirements.title: Cross-market economic rationale
requirements.description: Require an explicit economic rationale for every pair or basket.
requirements.acceptance: Experiment metadata includes rationale and invalidation conditions.

requirements.title: Rolling regression
requirements.description: Estimate rolling relationships without future leakage.

requirements.title: Hedge-ratio estimation
requirements.description: Estimate and version hedge ratios used in spreads.

requirements.title: Cointegration analysis
requirements.description: Test cointegration where appropriate and document limitations.
requirements.acceptance: Research report includes test configuration and result.

requirements.title: Spread stationarity analysis
requirements.description: Test the constructed residual/spread for stationarity.
requirements.acceptance: Report includes test and structural caveats.

requirements.title: Half-life estimation
requirements.description: Estimate mean-reversion half-life when model assumptions are defensible.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic process test recovers approximate known half-life.

requirements.title: Structural-break detection
requirements.description: Detect or flag breakdowns in historical relationships.
requirements.acceptance: Seeded break scenario is detected within documented tolerance.

requirements.title: Cross-market cost-aware signals
requirements.description: Apply realistic spread, fees, slippage, and execution delays to stat-arb.
requirements.acceptance: Gross and net results are both reported.

requirements.title: Volatility-regime features
requirements.description: Calculate realized volatility, range/ATR, autocorrelation, volume, spread, imbalance, and distance-to-extreme features as available.

requirements.title: Regime classification
requirements.description: Classify quiet, expansion, trend, reversal, and transition states using documented rules/models.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic scenario fixtures map to expected regimes.

requirements.title: Regime-conditioned trading
requirements.description: Enable strategy only in historically supported regimes.
requirements.acceptance: Ablation compares conditioned and unconditional variants.

requirements.title: Microstructure execution signal
requirements.description: Optionally research queue imbalance, microprice, order flow, spread reversion, or adverse-selection signals.
requirements.acceptance: No profitability claim without out-of-sample cost-aware evidence.

requirements.title: Lead-lag research
requirements.description: Measure lagged cross-market relationships without claiming causation from correlation alone.
requirements.acceptance: Report distinguishes prediction, association, and causation.

requirements.title: Strategy plugin interface
requirements.description: Strategies implement a stable interface and cannot bypass risk or OMS.
requirements.acceptance: Dependency and integration tests enforce the path.

requirements.title: Multiple strategy families
requirements.description: Calendar spread, cross-market/stat-arb, and volatility-regime strategies remain separate first-class modules.
requirements.acceptance: Demo and traceability show all three families implemented.

requirements.title: Research reproducibility
requirements.description: Every run stores config, data version, code commit, seed, date range, costs, and roll method.

requirements.title: Rolling mean
requirements.description: Update fixed-window mean without full recomputation.

requirements.title: Rolling variance
requirements.description: Update fixed-window variance with numerically stable add/remove logic.
requirements.acceptance: Matches trusted offline calculations within tolerance.

requirements.title: Rolling standard deviation
requirements.description: Expose stable rolling standard deviation.
requirements.acceptance: Edge cases and equivalence tests pass.

requirements.title: Rolling covariance
requirements.description: Update covariance online.

requirements.title: Rolling correlation
requirements.description: Update correlation online with zero-variance handling.
requirements.acceptance: Matches offline fixture and edge cases.

requirements.title: Rolling z-score
requirements.description: Compute leakage-free z-scores from prior/current window according to documented convention.

requirements.title: Exponential statistics
requirements.description: Support EW mean/variance with documented decay conventions.

requirements.title: Realized volatility and beta
requirements.description: Calculate realized volatility and rolling beta.

requirements.title: Online drawdown and P&L moments
requirements.description: Track high-water mark, drawdown, mean, variance, and higher moments where used.

requirements.title: Numerical/performance validation
requirements.description: Compare C++ online output, error, latency, and memory against Python reference.

requirements.title: Order lifecycle state machine
requirements.description: Track Created, RiskPending, Rejected, Submitted, Acknowledged, PartiallyFilled, Filled, CancelPending, Cancelled, and Expired states.
requirements.acceptance: Invalid transitions are rejected; transition tests cover all states.

requirements.title: Market-order execution
requirements.description: Model aggressive market execution.
requirements.acceptance: Integration tests reconcile fills and positions.

requirements.title: Passive limit execution
requirements.description: Model resting limit orders and queue-dependent fills.
requirements.acceptance: Scenario tests cover fill and nonfill outcomes.

requirements.title: Aggressive limit execution
requirements.description: Model crossing limits with price caps.
requirements.acceptance: Scenario tests cover multiple levels and residuals.

requirements.title: Cancel/amend lifecycle
requirements.description: Model acknowledgements, races, and rejection outcomes for cancel/modify.

requirements.title: Network and exchange latency
requirements.description: Model configurable feed, decision, gateway, exchange, and acknowledgement latency.

requirements.title: Partial fills
requirements.description: OMS handles multiple fills and remaining quantities.

requirements.title: Queue-position approximation
requirements.description: Estimate volume ahead, cancellation assumptions, traded volume, and fill probability when order-level truth is unavailable.
requirements.acceptance: Model limitations are explicit and synthetic validation exists.

requirements.title: Fees and slippage
requirements.description: Apply configurable fees, spread crossing, and slippage.

requirements.title: Missed trades
requirements.description: Record signals that were not filled and their opportunity cost.

requirements.title: Position and cash accounting
requirements.description: Maintain positions, average price, realized/unrealized P&L, and cash.

requirements.title: Environment-independent OMS
requirements.description: OMS connects to simulated exchange and later paper adapter through interfaces.

requirements.title: Mandatory risk path
requirements.description: No strategy or Decision Arena action may submit directly to an exchange adapter.

requirements.title: Maximum order quantity
requirements.description: Reject or resize orders above per-instrument quantity limits.

requirements.title: Maximum position
requirements.description: Enforce long/short position limits.

requirements.title: Maximum notional
requirements.description: Enforce per-order and portfolio notional limits.
requirements.acceptance: Multi-currency normalization tests pass or unsupported scope is explicit.

requirements.title: Per-market and sector exposure
requirements.description: Enforce market and grouped exposure limits.

requirements.title: Price collars
requirements.description: Reject orders beyond configurable reference-price collars.

requirements.title: Stale-data rejection
requirements.description: Block trading on stale or invalid market state.

requirements.title: Duplicate-order protection
requirements.description: Prevent duplicate client requests and replayed submissions.

requirements.title: Message-rate limits
requirements.description: Throttle or reject excessive order/cancel rates.

requirements.title: Margin availability
requirements.description: Estimate and enforce available margin using documented simplified or exchange-specific model.
requirements.acceptance: Scenario fixtures pass and limitations are stated.

requirements.title: Maximum leverage
requirements.description: Enforce leverage limits.

requirements.title: Daily loss limit
requirements.description: Stop or reduce trading after daily loss threshold.

requirements.title: Maximum drawdown
requirements.description: Stop or reduce trading after drawdown threshold.

requirements.title: Volatility-triggered reduction
requirements.description: Resize or reject risk as volatility rises.

requirements.title: Concentration and correlation limits
requirements.description: Limit concentrated or highly correlated portfolio exposures.

requirements.title: Strategy and portfolio kill switches
requirements.description: Provide idempotent strategy-level and global shutdown.
requirements.acceptance: Kill-switch tests cancel/disable safely and prevent new orders.

requirements.title: Connectivity-loss response
requirements.description: Define safe behavior on feed, exchange, or broker disconnect.

requirements.title: Risk decision audit
requirements.description: Emit approve, resize, or reject events with reason codes.
requirements.acceptance: Every proposal has exactly one auditable risk decision.

requirements.title: Portfolio risk analytics
requirements.description: Report gross/net exposure, margin, strategy/market risk, volatility and drawdown contribution, and stress results.
requirements.acceptance: Dashboard/report fixture reconciles with portfolio state.

requirements.title: Train/validation/test separation
requirements.description: Maintain explicit chronological or otherwise justified data partitions.

requirements.title: Rolling walk-forward testing
requirements.description: Train and test through rolling windows.
requirements.acceptance: Fixture verifies window boundaries and no leakage.

requirements.title: Expanding-window testing
requirements.description: Support expanding training windows.

requirements.title: Parameter-stability surfaces
requirements.description: Evaluate neighborhoods rather than only the best parameter point.
requirements.acceptance: Report renders and stores a stability surface.

requirements.title: Transaction-cost sensitivity
requirements.description: Sweep fees, spread, and slippage assumptions.

requirements.title: Latency sensitivity
requirements.description: Sweep decision/execution delays.

requirements.title: Slippage sensitivity
requirements.description: Sweep slippage and fill assumptions.

requirements.title: Bootstrap confidence intervals
requirements.description: Bootstrap appropriate return/trade statistics with documented assumptions.

requirements.title: Monte Carlo trade-sequence resampling
requirements.description: Resample trade order to analyze drawdown/path risk.

requirements.title: Multiple-market validation
requirements.description: Evaluate hypotheses across relevant markets/contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Report does not rely on one cherry-picked instrument.

requirements.title: Regime-specific evaluation
requirements.description: Break performance down by market regime.

requirements.title: Random-signal baseline
requirements.description: Compare against a random or shuffled baseline where meaningful.

requirements.title: Simple-rule baseline
requirements.description: Compare against a simpler strategy.

requirements.title: Look-ahead-bias detection
requirements.description: Automated tests prevent future data use.

requirements.title: Feature/data leakage checks
requirements.description: Validate timestamps, fitting scope, and transformations.

requirements.title: Roll-method sensitivity
requirements.description: Compare research outcomes across futures roll conventions.

requirements.title: Strategy rejection report
requirements.description: System can formally reject a strategy for costs, instability, concentration, test failure, or drawdown.
requirements.acceptance: At least one intentionally weak strategy produces a rejection report.

requirements.title: Return and risk metrics
requirements.description: Report total/annualized return, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, and maximum drawdown.

requirements.title: Trade metrics
requirements.description: Report win rate, profit factor, average win/loss, expectancy, turnover, and holding period.

requirements.title: Market and contract attribution
requirements.description: Break results down by market and contract.

requirements.title: Strategy attribution
requirements.description: Break results down by strategy.

requirements.title: Regime attribution
requirements.description: Break results down by regime.

requirements.title: Long/short attribution
requirements.description: Separate long and short performance.

requirements.title: Session/time attribution
requirements.description: Break results down by hour/session where timestamps support it.

requirements.title: Entry/execution attribution
requirements.description: Break results down by entry and execution method.

requirements.title: Gross/net attribution
requirements.description: Separate gross alpha from fees, spread, slippage, latency, and roll impact.

requirements.title: Fill ratio
requirements.description: Report fill ratio by order type and strategy.

requirements.title: Average slippage and time-to-fill
requirements.description: Report execution quality distributions.

requirements.title: Adverse selection
requirements.description: Measure post-fill price movement at configured horizons.

requirements.title: Passive/aggressive comparison
requirements.description: Compare passive and aggressive execution.

requirements.title: Queue-model diagnostics
requirements.description: Evaluate queue-position estimates where ground truth exists or on simulation.

requirements.title: Cancellation/rejection rates
requirements.description: Report cancellation and rejection statistics.

requirements.title: Latency attribution
requirements.description: Break total decision-to-ack/fill path into feed, strategy, risk, gateway, exchange, and response components.

requirements.title: Historical market scenarios
requirements.description: Create scenarios from deterministic replay with information frozen at decision time.
requirements.acceptance: Scenario hash and timestamp provenance are stored.

requirements.title: Visible market context
requirements.description: Display recent price, bid/ask, depth, spread, volatility, position, P&L, and selected indicators.

requirements.title: Timed actions
requirements.description: Support BUY, SELL, HOLD, REDUCE, EXIT, and PASS under strict timers.

requirements.title: Confidence capture
requirements.description: Capture configured confidence levels such as 55/70/85/95 percent.
requirements.acceptance: Input validation and persistence tests pass.

requirements.title: Response-time scoring
requirements.description: Measure response time using a monotonic clock.

requirements.title: Action-quality scoring
requirements.description: Score decisions using predeclared scenario policy/model rather than hindsight alone.

requirements.title: Outcome scoring
requirements.description: Separately record realized simulated outcome.

requirements.title: Risk compliance scoring
requirements.description: Penalize or reject decisions that violate risk rules.

requirements.title: Overtrading detection
requirements.description: Measure unnecessary action frequency.

requirements.title: Passivity detection
requirements.description: Measure missed high-confidence opportunities.

requirements.title: Post-win/loss behavior
requirements.description: Analyze decisions after gains and losses.

requirements.title: Leading/trailing behavior
requirements.description: Analyze risk-taking while score/P&L is ahead or behind.

requirements.title: Regime consistency
requirements.description: Analyze behavior across market regimes.

requirements.title: Futures First scoring mode
requirements.description: Provide levels ±1, ±2, ±3, ±4, bonus ±6, and pass 0.

requirements.title: Copyable result report
requirements.description: Generate compact reports containing score, speed, accuracy, risk, confidence, and level/category detail.

requirements.title: Recruitment/cohort mode
requirements.description: Support standardized scenario sets and anonymized cohort comparison without claiming employment prediction.

requirements.title: Alternative-action simulation
requirements.description: Compute outcomes for feasible alternative actions using the same future path and execution assumptions.

requirements.title: Decision/outcome separation
requirements.description: Maintain distinct decision-quality and outcome-quality scores.
requirements.acceptance: Data schema and UI display both.

requirements.title: No hindsight leakage in decision score
requirements.description: Decision quality uses only information available at decision time.

requirements.title: Counterfactual explanation
requirements.description: Explain chosen and alternative outcomes, assumptions, and uncertainty.

requirements.title: Execution-aware counterfactuals
requirements.description: Alternative actions use realistic fill/latency assumptions, not perfect prices.

requirements.title: Uncertainty labeling
requirements.description: Label model-dependent counterfactuals as estimates.

requirements.title: Confidence-bin accuracy
requirements.description: Compare declared confidence with empirical success by bin.

requirements.title: Brier score
requirements.description: Calculate Brier score for probabilistic decisions.

requirements.title: Calibration error
requirements.description: Calculate a documented calibration-error metric.

requirements.title: Answer and pass rates
requirements.description: Measure participation and pass behavior.

requirements.title: Response time by confidence
requirements.description: Report speed by confidence level.

requirements.title: Risk after wins/losses
requirements.description: Measure risk-taking following wins and losses.

requirements.title: Overconfidence and underconfidence
requirements.description: Detect statistically meaningful calibration direction with caveats.

requirements.title: Action consistency
requirements.description: Measure consistency for materially similar scenarios.

requirements.title: Regime-specific weakness
requirements.description: Report calibration and performance by regime.

requirements.title: Recruitment/training usage
requirements.description: Support personal development, coaching, competitions, and assessment while avoiding deterministic hiring claims.

requirements.title: Market Replay workspace
requirements.description: Choose instrument/date, control replay, inspect book/trades, and inject faults.
requirements.acceptance: End-to-end UI test completes a replay flow.

requirements.title: Research Lab workspace
requirements.description: Configure strategies, markets, periods, and experiments.
requirements.acceptance: End-to-end UI test launches and retrieves an experiment.

requirements.title: Risk Console
requirements.description: Display positions, P&L, margin, exposures, breaches, and kill-switch status.
requirements.acceptance: UI values reconcile with API fixture.

requirements.title: Decision Arena workspace
requirements.description: Run timed scenarios and show result analytics.
requirements.acceptance: End-to-end UI test completes a scenario set.

requirements.title: Performance Lab
requirements.description: Display strategy, execution, latency, risk, and robustness analytics.

requirements.title: Experiment ID
requirements.description: Assign immutable unique IDs.

requirements.title: Git commit capture
requirements.description: Record code commit for every experiment.

requirements.title: Data version capture
requirements.description: Record dataset/version identifiers.

requirements.title: Configuration capture
requirements.description: Save full resolved configuration.

requirements.title: Date/contract/roll capture
requirements.description: Record date range, contracts, and roll method.

requirements.title: Cost and seed capture
requirements.description: Record cost assumptions and random seed.

requirements.title: Artifact registry
requirements.description: Register reports, logs, metrics, and plots by experiment.

requirements.title: Re-run command
requirements.description: Generate a reproducible rerun command.
requirements.acceptance: Clean rerun reproduces key outputs within tolerance.

requirements.title: Backend/frontend separation
requirements.description: UI consumes versioned APIs rather than reaching into engine internals.

requirements.title: Accessibility and usability
requirements.description: Core dashboard and Decision Arena flows are keyboard-usable and expose clear timer/status states.

requirements.title: Live/delayed market-data adapter
requirements.description: Add a versioned adapter without changing strategy interfaces.
requirements.acceptance: Contract tests match replay feed interface.

requirements.title: Broker paper adapter
requirements.description: Submit only to a paper/sandbox environment.

requirements.title: Position reconciliation
requirements.description: Reconcile internal and broker-paper positions.
requirements.acceptance: Mismatch scenario creates an alert and safe state.

requirements.title: Restart recovery
requirements.description: Recover OMS/portfolio state from snapshots/events.

requirements.title: Connectivity monitoring
requirements.description: Detect disconnects and invoke safe behavior.

requirements.title: Daily paper report
requirements.description: Generate positions, trades, P&L, risk, and anomalies.

requirements.title: No real-money execution
requirements.description: Initial project has no enabled production trading path.
requirements.acceptance: Configuration and code audit find no production endpoint enabled.

requirements.title: Same strategy interface
requirements.description: Strategies run unchanged across replay, simulation, and paper environments.
requirements.acceptance: One strategy passes all adapter contract tests.

requirements.title: Modern C++ toolchain
requirements.description: Use C++20 or newer, CMake presets, strict warnings, sanitizers, static analysis, and tests.
requirements.acceptance: CI builds debug/release and runs configured checks.

requirements.title: Python research toolchain
requirements.description: Use a pinned Python environment for data, research, validation, and reports.

requirements.title: C++/Python bindings
requirements.description: Use pybind11 or a documented equivalent for selected engine APIs.

requirements.title: Columnar data interchange
requirements.description: Use Parquet/Arrow and DuckDB where suitable with versioned schemas.

requirements.title: Configuration system
requirements.description: Use versioned validated YAML/TOML/JSON configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Invalid configs fail with clear errors.

requirements.title: Structured logging
requirements.description: Emit machine-readable logs with event/experiment correlation IDs.

requirements.title: Unit, integration, property and replay tests
requirements.description: Maintain distinct test layers.

requirements.title: Continuous integration
requirements.description: CI runs spec audit, build, tests, static checks, and secret scanning.

requirements.title: Documentation
requirements.description: Architecture, methods, assumptions, limitations, runbooks, and demo steps remain current.
requirements.acceptance: Documentation audit maps claims to code/evidence.

requirements.title: Sample data policy
requirements.description: Commit only small legally redistributable samples; large/licensed data stays external.

requirements.title: Failure recovery
requirements.description: Critical stateful services document shutdown, snapshot, and recovery behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Recovery tests exist for exchange and participant state.

requirements.title: Observability
requirements.description: Expose health, queue depth, dropped/backpressured events, latency, and risk status.
